task: You are an automated code review/build agent. Explore the ENTIRE TMT codebase in repository M3-mo2/TMT and identify ALL gaps and missing pieces that prevent the project from being complete and production-ready. Categories to investigate: (1) CI/CD pipeline issues — broken workflows, missing automation, BOT_NAME mismatches, failed permission checks, label state-machine gaps; (2) Incomplete features — stubbed/todo/not-implemented functions, partially-built features; (3) Missing documentation — absent README sections, missing guides, absent API docs; (4) Missing or inadequate tests — missing test files for modules, low coverage areas; (5) Configuration/scaffolding gaps — missing setup.py/pyproject, missing requirements, missing .env, missing linting config, missing pre-commit hooks; (6) Code quality defects — TODO/FIXME markers, unused imports, security issues. Produce a single report file named GAPS_REPORT.md at the repository root. The report MUST be organized by category, each gap with a severity (Critical/High/Medium/Low) and a concrete description + file location when possible. Do NOT fix any gaps — only document them. Do NOT modify existing application code. Deliver only the new report file.

findings.title: Duplicate priority #8 in Summary priorities list
findings.detail: The Fix Agent's reorganization of the Summary priorities list introduced a duplicate numbering — two items are both numbered '8' (both 'Resolve the emoji policy contradiction'). The original report had unique priorities 1-8 with only one emoji item. The Fix Agent's comment claims to have 'fixed a resulting duplicate-numbering bug' but the duplicate persists at the end of the list.

findings.title: Missing 'Add tests for admin routers' priority in Summary
findings.detail: The Fix Agent's reorganization removed the original priority 7 ('Add tests for admin routers — channels.py and users.py are 500+ lines of untested CRUD') without explanation. This was a legitimate High-severity recommendation aligned with §3's finding of 23 untested modules and the entire untested admin router tree. It should be re-added to the priorities list.

findings.title: delete_notification 'no caller anywhere' claim is inaccurate
findings.detail: The Fix Agent's §4.1 states delete_notification has 'no caller anywhere in the codebase (only its definition in repositories.py:928)'. This is incorrect — tests/test_notifications.py:230 calls repo.delete_notification(db, nid). The broader claim (latent IDOR, no production caller) is correct, but 'no caller anywhere' is too broad and inaccurate.

findings.title: except Exception count is inaccurate
findings.detail: The report states '38 occurrences across 17 source files' for broad except Exception. A grep for 'except Exception' in app/ finds 48 occurrences across 17 files. The file count (17) is correct, but the occurrence count is off by 10.
